name: post.linkedin
description: Lane B: Rodgers Intelligence B2B. Evidence-led, named receipts. Pop-culture hooks ARE allowed; the proprietary cast is not.

unverified_claim.instructions: States a metric, result, or outcome that is NEITHER reported first-hand from the author's own work or measurement, NOR attributed to a named source. A first-person report of what the author personally measured or observed is sourced and is NOT a violation; an unattributed claim about the industry, a third party, or 'studies' is.

banned_words.instructions: Uses any of: unlock, empower, synergy, leverage, disrupt, hustle, utilize, iterate, optimize

hook_strength.instructions: How strongly does the opening line earn the next line
criteria: Stops the scroll and names a real tension

proprietary_cast.instructions: References Birch, Unit 7, The Coach, or the phrase 'Be more Birch' -- the personal-brand cast, which must never appear in RIG B2B content

named_receipt.instructions: Contains a concrete, named, checkable receipt: a number with a source, a named system, or a specific outcome

buyer_relevant.instructions: Speaks to an operator who owns a workflow and a budget, rather than to other AI enthusiasts

one_idea.instructions: The post carries one idea rather than a list of loosely related thoughts

rules.reason: Lane A cast leaking into Lane B
no named receipt -- Lane B runs on evidence

notes.unverified_claim: reworded 2026-09-18 after a false block on a first-person audit post (decision id 6)
